desk_plant.name: SMALL DESK PLANT
desk_plant.description: A SMALL GREEN DESK PLANT IN A WHITE PLASTIC POT. A PENCIL LINE MARKS THE RECOMMENDED WATER LEVEL. NOBODY APPEARS TO HAVE OBSERVED IT.

red_stapler.name: RED SWANGLINE STAPLER
red_stapler.description: A HEAVY RED METAL DESK STAPLER. SWANGLINE IS PRINTED IN SILVER LETTERS ON THE SIDE. NO ONE EVER AGREED WHETHER IT BELONGED TO YOU OR THE OFFICE.

rubber_band_ball.name: RUBBER-BAND BALL
rubber_band_ball.description: A DENSE BALL OF OFFICE RUBBER BANDS, WOUND OVER MANY YEARS. YOU CAN'T TELL WHAT ALL THOSE BANDS ARE WOUND AROUND.

THE TAG READS:

ISSUED TO: EXAMINER, OFFICE OF UNVERIFIED CONDITIONS.
RETURNED: TODAY, 4:52.
SIGNED: (A SIGNATURE IN WHAT IS PLAINLY YOUR OWN HANDWRITING.)

THE CROOKED CAMERA CATCHES PART OF A FOURTH CHAIR AT THE RIGHT EDGE, WITH PART OF YOUR SHIRT, LAP, LEGS AND FORWARD-FACING SHOES. YOUR HEAD IS OUT OF FRAME. THE BACK IS STAMPED OFFICIAL HOUSEHOLD RECORD - COMPLIMENTARY COPY.
